subject.title: Feature: configurable LLM profiles with fast model switching in Telegram

question: Should this issue be narrowed to ordered alias-first presentation of existing configured models, or should OpenClaw introduce a new profile object that also bundles fallbacks, auth profile, reasoning, and runtime settings?
rationale: The alias-first picker gap is concrete, but a full profile object creates a new public configuration, precedence, persistence, and upgrade contract that current source cannot decide.

options.title: Alias-first picker
options.body: Extend existing configured model entries with ordered display metadata and reuse the current portable session-selection path.

options.title: Full profile objects
options.body: Design a new generic schema with explicit migration, precedence, auth, fallback, runtime, and session semantics before implementation.

options.title: Document direct aliases
options.body: Keep the provider-first picker and treat `/model <alias>` as the supported fast-switch workflow.

recommendation.title: Alias-first picker
recommendation.body: Extend existing configured model entries with ordered display metadata and reuse the current portable session-selection path.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history shows the broadest involvement in the exact model-picker, runtime-choice, Telegram scope, and session-persistence decisions.
